text:
reena: quick note — support reported tenant saw v2 p95 jump but billing shows tokens under v1 during a short outage window.
sam: likely the emergency fallback path. did routing emit a marker?
reena: only a log line "fallback=degenerate_to_v1" in the service logs, not surfaced to telemetry or console.
oliver: we need a canonical model_resolution event with requested_model, served_model, serve_region_coarse, and fallback_reason. downstream systems (billing, console) must join on that.
reena: agree. UX ask: console should show a simple reconciliation badge: percent mismatched and example traces, plus CSV export.
ina: ops-bot: suggest alert if global mismatch >0.5% in 5m or tenant >1% over 1h. also send tenant banner when >2% over 24h.
sam: implement coarse region tag to avoid cardinality: same_region | cross_region | cross_cloud. raw region only in sampled traces.
oliver: SDK header idea: x-rw-allow-cross-region: yes/ask/no. default ask for new SDKs; console tenant toggle for override.
reena: timeline: week 1 telemetry + model_resolution, week 2 billing dual-write + reconcile job, week 3 console panel + banner, week 5 SDK header enforcement.
sam: I'll do the telemetry PR and coarse mapping.
oliver: I'll update routing to set resolved fields.
nina: I'll draft alert rules and banner copy.
reena: thanks — filing RFC and will review in eng-platform sync. :thumbsup:
